load_lora_weights: load LoRA weights into a diffusers pipeline from a local path or Hugging Face Hub repository
fuse_lora_components: fuse LoRA adapter weights into the original model parameters for specified pipeline components
set_adapters_weights: set active LoRA adapters and their weights for a diffusers pipeline with multiple loaded adapters
delete_adapters_pipeline: delete specific LoRA adapter layers from all LoRA-loadable components in a pipeline
save_lora_weights: save LoRA adapter weights and optional metadata to disk in safetensors or pickle format
